text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm rounding a corner...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh no, oh no, oh no! L-look out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! I was in such a huge rush
that I—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Sorry, but I made a promise,
so I'll be—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I completely forgot that I promised to
race with
my friend, so I'm rushing over
there now...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I give it my all now, I'll be out of
energy when
it's time for the real race
with my friend!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty, I'll just jog slowly in the
hallway to
recover my strength!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Thanks, and I'm sorry for crashing
into you!
Bye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week runs off again in a panic,
however...
